boundaries.startup: Popen dispatch to owned mapped GTK window, visible editor save control, real XTest Tab focus roundtrip, and X11 screenshot completion. Screenshot acquisition/AT-SPI polling observer overhead included.
boundaries.first_on_clone: First process on freshly backed-up synthetic database; schema migration may be included. OS page cache uncontrolled.
boundaries.repeated_startup: New process each sample, same initialized profile; OS page cache warm/uncontrolled, AT-SPI session preinitialized. Not machine-cold.
boundaries.search: AT-SPI text replacement dispatch to exact expected product title in a visible selectable and sensitive list item; includes debounce, rendering, AT-SPI observer overhead.
boundaries.rss: Owned application /proc VmRSS and kernel VmHWM in KiB, polled every 10ms from process launch. Steady after 500ms idle; peak excludes X server, accessibility registry and helpers.

limits: No OS-cache flush, physical cold launch, SSD hardware declaration, or reference four-core/8GB certification. Binary hashing and SQLite copying warm their file pages before launch; library/font cache state is uncontrolled.
No five-year/100,000-document/1,000,000-journal-line/10,000-party fixture; small G1 and existing 50,000-product/1,000-line quote only.
External AT-SPI polling/screenshot observer affects latency; p99 for n=10 is simply the worst sample.
